usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the full configuration of a specific storage pool by its ID — including type, content flags, path/server details, and enabled state. The caller must hold `Datastore.Allocate` on `/storage/{storage}`, which is typically restricted to administrators. This operates on the cluster-level storage config, not a per-node view, so the result is authoritative regardless of which node you query.

examples.summary: Read configuration for a local ZFS storage pool

tips: The returned object shape varies by storage type (e.g., `dir`, `zfspool`, `nfs`, `cifs`, `rbd`) — type-specific fields are only present for the matching backend.
To list all storage IDs available on the cluster before querying a specific one, call `get_storage` first.
This endpoint reads the cluster config (`/etc/pve/storage.cfg`), not live mount/availability status — use node-level storage queries to check if a storage is currently active on a specific node.
